How It Works

Sell Your Gold in 4 Simple Steps

The entire process takes about 10–15 minutes at our Gaur City Centre counter. No hidden steps, no surprises, no damage to your jewellery.

1

Walk Into Our Store

Visit us at Shop No. GF-04, Gaur City Centre, Gaur Chowk, Sector 4, Greater Noida West with your jewellery and one valid photo ID (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport or Driving Licence).

2

Free XRF Testing

Your gold's purity is tested live on a German XRF Karatmeter. The result appears on screen in front of you — 100% transparent, zero damage.

3

Clear Valuation

We weigh your item in front of you and calculate the value from the live market rate and tested purity. Every number is explained — no hidden deductions.

4

Instant Payment

Accept the offer and get paid immediately by cash, NEFT or RTGS, with a proper invoice. The full process takes about 10–15 minutes.

Why the XRF Test Matters

Older testing methods — acid and touchstone — scratch the surface of your jewellery and only estimate purity. A German XRF (X-ray fluorescence) Karatmeter measures the exact metal composition without touching or damaging the piece, and displays the result on a screen you can read yourself. That one difference removes almost every dispute about purity — and it is why we can value hallmarked, non-hallmarked, old and even broken jewellery fairly.

No Obligation at Any Step

Testing and valuation are free. If our offer doesn't suit you, you are free to compare with any other buyer and come back — your jewellery leaves with you, exactly as it arrived.
